Nginx proxy manager.description:
Managing Nginx proxy hosts with a simple, powerful interface.

Based on the official OCI image, available for amd64 and arm64 architecture.

Note: if the UI does not come up within a few minutes after the first startup, you might have to restart the Rock-on so it recognizes the adjusted share ownerships that the initialization performs.

443.description: Port where nginx will listen for https connections.
443.label: Https port [e.g. 4443]

80.description: Port where nginx will listen for http connections.
80.label: Http port [e.g. 8080]

/etc/letsencrypt.description: This is where certificates are stored (e.g. from Let's Encrypt).
/etc/letsencrypt.label: Certificate storage [e.g. npm-certs]

PUID.description: UID to run Nginx Proxy Manager as.
PUID.label: UID

PGID.description: Enter a valid GID to use along with the same UID. It (or the above UID) must have full permissions to all shares mapped in the previous step.
PGID.label: GID
